anomalies.observed: C1 on the EPD power-switch rail is drawn with value '0.1uF/16V'.
anomalies.expected: C1 is one of the PDI-reference default capacitors and should be 1 uF / 25 V (spec groups it with 'C1/C5/C7/C8/C9/C10 = 1 µF/25 V').

evidence.quote: EPD_Driver.kicad_sch: C1 value field reads '0.1uF/16V' (C2 next to it reads '1uF/6.3V').
| C2 default: 1 µF/25 V | C1/C5/C7/C8/C9/C10 = 1 µF/25 V | Matches default |

anomalies.impact: The EPD panel's VDD/VDDIO (Display_Power_Switch) rail is decoupled with 10x less capacitance than the reference circuit intends, so the display supply sees more ripple and the boost/charge-pump stage has a weaker local reservoir.

anomalies.observed: The EthernetAndPower sheet contains only C11 (0.1 uF, at the RJ45) and C13 (10 uF, at the +3V3 output); no C12 symbol exists anywhere on the BAT+ rail feeding IC1.
anomalies.expected: A 2.2 uF input capacitor (C12) from BAT+ to GND at the FAN53610 VIN, as required by the spec and by the FAN53610 datasheet's recommended CIN.

evidence.quote: `C12` (2.2 µF) on `BAT+`→GND is the input cap; `C13` (10 µF) on `+3V3`→GND is the output cap

anomalies.impact: The buck regulator has no local input capacitance on BAT+, giving poor input decoupling / higher input ripple and possible instability when the switching load steps, contrary to the intended design.

parsed.summary: The build deviates from the specified reference in the analog/power sections: the EPD rail decoupling cap C1 is drawn as 0.1 uF/16 V instead of the specified 1 uF/25 V, and the FAN53610's specified 2.2 uF input capacitor C12 is absent from the BAT+ rail. Both are direct contradictions of explicit statements in the design specification, so an anomaly is reported, though overall confidence is only moderate because these were read from a rendered schematic.
